facts.business: PTC Industries Limited is an integrated producer of aerospace-grade materials and components, serving global aerospace, defence, and energy customers through its subsidiaries Aerolloy Technologies Limited and Trac Precision Solutions Limited.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Reporting under Rule 11(g) of the Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014
